name: System isomorphism is symmetric
description: Theorem 4.38: Z1 = ISY(Z2, HS, HI, HO) if and only if Z2 = ISY(Z1, HS^-1, HI^-1, HO^-1).

elements.text: Z1 is isomorphic to Z2 iff Z2 is isomorphic to Z1, via the inverse isomorphisms.
HS, HI, HO are bijective, so their inverses are bijective and satisfy the transition and readout consistency conditions.
